subject: How often do bank feeds update?

messages.name: Wonderland Media admin
messages.body: The FAQ says feeds sync once a day but we see new transactions more often. Which is right?

messages.name: Maya (Support)
messages.body: Since 2.3.0, bank feeds sync every 4 hours. The FAQ page is out of date; we've flagged it.

messages.name: Wonderland Media admin
messages.body: OK. Please let us know when it's fixed.
